name: com.placesdataapi/google-maps-places-reviews-geocoding-mcp
title: PlacesDataAPI — Google Maps Places, Reviews & Geocoding MCP. Zero-signup x40
description: Google Maps Places, Reviews & Geocoding MCP. Zero-signup x402 USDC ($0.0015) on Base or API key.

tools.name: places_search
tools.description: Search Google Maps local businesses in real time by natural-language query (e.g. "HVAC contractors in Austin, TX") and return ratings, review counts, E.164 phone numbers, website domains, street addresses, opening hours, Place IDs, CIDs, and GPS coordinates. Cost: 5 Credits / place returned ($0.20–$0.50/1K places; 0 Credits if empty).

q.description: Natural-language search query, e.g. "Specialty coffee roasters in Austin, TX" or "Dental clinics in Miami, FL".

limit.description: Maximum number of places to return (1–100).

enrich_contacts.description: Set true to crawl returned business websites in real time for public B2B emails and social profiles.

tools.name: places_nearby
tools.description: Discover Google Maps businesses inside a geographic viewport around exact GPS coordinates (lat, lng, zoom). Cost: 5 Credits / place returned (0 Credits if empty).

q.description: Optional category or keyword filter, e.g. "plumber" or "coffee".

tools.name: places_details
tools.description: Retrieve the complete Google Business Profile by place_id, cid, or hex google_id including 1–5 star rating distribution, E.164 phone, website, categories, weekly work hours, and coordinates. Cost: 20 Credits / place (+20 if enrich_contacts=true and contacts found).

place_id.description: Google Maps Place ID (e.g. "ChIJ..."), numeric CID, or hex feature ID ("0x...:0x...").

enrich_contacts.description: If true, also crawls the business website domain for B2B emails and social links.

tools.name: places_reviews
tools.description: Extract verified customer reviews for any Google Maps business sorted by newest, most_relevant, highest_rating, or lowest_rating, including reviewer profile, star rating, text, owner reply, and review photos. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned ($0.08–$0.20/1K reviews; 0 Credits if empty).

place_id.description: Google Maps Place ID ("ChIJ..."), CID, or hex feature ID.

tools.name: places_photos
tools.description: Retrieve high-resolution storefront, interior, and menu photo URLs and dimensions for any Google Maps place. Cost: 2 Credits / photo returned (0 Credits if empty).

place_id.description: Google Maps Place ID ("ChIJ..."), CID, or hex feature ID.

tools.name: leads_enrich
tools.description: Crawl a local business website domain in real time to extract public B2B email addresses, phone numbers, and LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X/Twitter, YouTube, and TikTok profile URLs. Cost: 20 Credits when emails or social links are found (0 Credits if empty).

domain.description: Business domain or website URL, e.g. "austindentalspa.com" or "https://houndstoothcoffee.com".

tools.name: places_autocomplete
tools.description: Real-time typeahead place and street address predictions with optional coordinate and country biasing. Cost: 5 Credits / call (0 Credits if empty).

q.description: Partial place name or street address input.

tools.name: geocode_reverse
tools.description: Convert raw GPS latitude and longitude coordinates into structured street addresses, Plus Codes, neighborhoods, and Google Place IDs. Cost: 5 Credits / call.

tools.name: whatsapp_check
tools.description: Validate whether an E.164 phone number is registered on WhatsApp, detect WhatsApp Business accounts, resolve its WhatsApp JID (<digits>@s.whatsapp.net), and return ITU international country/numbering plan metadata. Cost: 3 Credits / valid check ($0.12–$0.30 per 1K checks; 0 Credits on invalid synthetic numbers or errors).

phone.description: International E.164 phone number (e.g. "+18002428478" or "+447911123456"). Spaces and hyphens are stripped automatically.
